ADR 0038: the original node notification ID now also executes for native composition updates after DisplayServer commits its text and selection.

ADR 0038 and ADR 0004: typed owner-thread full-text replacement uses the focused LineEdit/TextEdit/CodeEdit Text setter. Embedded-window focus forwards recursively, native windows and direct SubViewports keep independent GUI focus, and a focused SubViewportContainer does not forward. Paused, read-only and GUI-input-disabled editors remain authorable. Null/disposed/off-owner/capture guards execute. TextChanged and Control.TextInput are suppressed; multiline TextSet is synchronous even for equal assignments, replacement preserves undo, and queued real user changes survive. ViewportTextInputTests covers routing, scalar limits, history, failures and current native renderer integration.

statusGroups.reason: ADRs 0002/0038/0044/0095: static GetWindowEvents selects a borrowed native-window publisher with standard typed subscriptions. Native child routing, owner validation, explicit/native retirement, callback replacement and failure continuation execute on existing SDL contexts. Input commits before publisher callbacks and scene delivery; untagged events broadcast to a retained cohort. DisplayWindowEventsTests and the public native consumer cover the contract; specialized platform producers and real IME/data offers retain their separate triggers. Committed strings and composition selection remain separate; actual input-method UI acceptance remains independent of callback registration.

Native SDL key events still carry Unicode zero. Complete committed strings and IME composition reach focused Controls separately under ADR 0038; per-key Unicode attribution needs a native source that identifies the producing key without guessing from later SDL text events.
